visual_text: CFS 6: moderate dementia; walks independently; needs prompting to dress
CFS 6: thinking intact; physical disability; needs someone standing by
The scale counts help needed from any cause. Write the reason next to the number.
Rockwood and Theou, Can Geriatr J 2020
alt_text: Two drawn scenes, both scoring CFS 6. On the left an older man with moderate dementia walks on his own while a carer helps with dressing. On the right a woman with intact thinking sits on a shower stool, a walking frame beside her, with a support worker standing by. Write the reason next to the number.
design_instructions: Single sand card, two equal drawn panels: older white man walking with carer helping to dress; older South Asian-heritage style woman on shower stool with frame and support worker. Labels below. No CFS pictograms.
